code:
print(run([2000]))               # 0.042 -- one look: ~alpha, as promised
print(run(range(200, 2001, 200))) # 0.2055 -- ten looks: ~20%!
caption: Fixed-sample tests are only valid for ONE look at the planned end. Need to monitor? Use sequential testing.
